title: Cold-Chain Evidence Ledger
reason: Too close to emberforge (identity canonicalisation, calibration, reconciliation, settlement-style reports) in the same Data Processing domain; G9 convergence risk.

title: Byte-Exact Vendor Archive Recovery
reason: New archetype for the registry; byte-exact round trip is objectively graded; levers new to registry. Risks: agent can self-test round trip on visible captures (opaque-extension lever may leak); decode.py/encode.py live at bundle root per archetype; stage-entry contract for supplied intermediates must be written in the instruction.

title: Data Product Configuration Compiler
reason: Good archetype fit (repair tool.zip). Absent/null/empty merge is a well-known idiom (likely leaks); selector-scope rule is ambiguity-prone (IN-16). Overlaps ideas 4 and 5 on null and idempotency themes.

title: Schema Migration Repository Repair
reason: Only idea with lever D (size ladder) plus state-dependent edge feasibility; repo repair adds C. Risks: careful agents use Dijkstra by reflex, so D must need the record-state product graph; planner state and tie-break must be fully written; null-provenance and replay levers overlap idea 3/5.

title: Ingestion Control-Plane Reconciliation
reason: Needs a full stateful simulator with competing workers and a logical clock; highest build cost and the idea itself names timing nondeterminism as its main risk. Revisit later as a service-interaction task.
